# The Gateway Layer: Routing, Cost, and Governance {#sec-gateway}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- justify a model gateway in terms of the problems it removes;
- enforce budgets, quotas, and rate limits per team and per key;
- build fallback and failover across providers;
- route by cost and capability without degrading quality.

## Exercises

1. Add exact-match caching to a real workload and measure the hit rate and the saving.
2. Design a routing rule that sends 70% of traffic to a cheaper model. Prove the quality loss is acceptable.
